paragraphs.text: Gorilla is an obsolete token creature type for a species of herbivorous, predominantly ground-dwelling great apes that inhabit tropical forests . It was later used on a playtest card .

Gorilla was originally introduced as a creature type in Alliances . Later in the Grand Creature Type Update , the creature type was incorporated in the Ape type. The type reappeared on Gorilla Tactics , a playtest card in the Mystery Booster set that created Gorilla tokens.

Gorillas are common on Dominaria ; the apes of Yavimaya are sapient and engage in a form of ancestor worship that draws strength from their forebears. . Zendikar features gorillas on Skyfang Peak of Akoum known as Summit Apes . Ikoria features Tigorillas, a tiger and gorilla hybrid with its back half being like a tiger and its front half being like a gorilla. On Kamigawa , the Kami of Industry is a kami that takes the appearance of a large white furred gorilla with six arms. The majority of Fang Druids of Muraganda are gorillas, though there are other great apes who they count among their numbers
